owner.title: Copyright holder ($author)
owner.description: Written after the year, e.g. "ACME Inc."; empty for none.

license.title: License, SPDX identifier ($license)
license.description: e.g. Apache-2.0, MIT, GPL-3.0-or-later; empty for no SPDX line in the default header.

profile.title: Active profile
profile.description: The name of a profile below. Empty, or a name that is not there: "Copyright (c) $year $author" and an SPDX line. Set it for This project to give a project its own profile.

profiles.title: Copyright profiles
profiles.description: Notice templates, one line per header line. Variables: $year (this year, or first-this when the existing header starts earlier), $author, $license, $project (the project folder) and $file.

commentStyles.title: Comment styles
commentStyles.description: How files with these extensions comment, overriding the built-in table; also gives a header to file types it lacks.

excludedFolders.title: Excluded folders
excludedFolders.description: Folder names Update Copyright and Find Files Without a Header skip inside the folder they run on (vendored code keeps its own notices), comma-separated.

addToNewFiles.title: Add the header to new files
addToNewFiles.description: An empty file created in the IDE (New File) gets the active profile's header when it opens.

reportOnOpen.title: Report files without a header when they open
